pre_gate_visual_inspection.scope: all 45 rendered pages of the exact PDF artifact
notes: Some TOC/Technical Notes tail pages retain large whitespace because the current layout begins major chapters on odd-numbered pages; no reader content is missing.

The rejected v0.3 candidate had 36 pages and insufficient reader-facing narrative depth. v0.4 supersedes it after evidence-bound redrafting and complete revalidation; the final candidate has 45 pages with the seven approved trajectories expanded to multi-page narrative treatment.
The 96-page target remains a soft planning envelope, not a minimum publication requirement; no filler pages were added merely to approach the target.

residual_boundaries: Vendor, project, and author capability/performance evaluations remain attributed rather than treated as independently reproduced results.
Nominal context-window size is not treated as evidence of uniformly effective long-context use.
Preview, paper publication, model release, API availability, device deployment, and product integration remain distinct chronology states.
Current publisher indexes and capped arXiv slices cannot establish historical absence.
One planned llama.cpp commit-level historical locator was unavailable and remains a runtime-history limitation.
